shell_commands: cat package.json | grep -A5 '"scripts"' | head -10; cat package.json | grep -A3 '"jest"' | head -15

git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(tools): use Ajv default import, add input validation to execute, fix lint errors

- Change named import {Ajv} to default import to fix ESM/CJS interop
- Add actual input validation in ToolRegistry.execute before calling the executor
- Use AJV v6 dataPath field (not v8 instancePath) in error formatter
- Attach cause to compileSchema error to satisfy preserve-caught-error rule
- Flip if-guard in acceptance test to satisfy prefer-early-return rule
- Extract member chain in acceptance test to satisfy max-member-chain rule

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main --no-edit 2>&1
